notes.title: Version 0.15 status and some thoughts about the next game.
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all![/p][p]
[/p][p]As I’m starting to wrap version 0.15, I find myself thinking more and more about Vae Victis - 2 (temporary name!) and there are two issues I’d like to consult with you guys about the next game’s design.[/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p][b]Should there be less girls but more content for each girl?[/b] In his travels, Karder meets many beautiful girls but most of them have only brief interactions with him and are never seen again. While this allows me to introduce a huge variety of races, body types and backstories, the overall experience can feel a bit unsatisfying to some of you. A frequent question I get almost since launch is “when can we see more of girl X?”. There’s a dilemma here: more girls = shorter interactions with each. Less girls = longer stories, more revisits and even palace stay for some.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]The other issue is about content affecting decisions: [b]should there be slightly more weight to decisions[/b] you make? In Vae Victis - Khan, very few decisions you make will give you a completely different outcome later on. A rare example is that if you abuse Alam or Fahda in the Ziruan oasis quest, you will not be able to revisit Fahda later. But in most cases, you will still be able to access all the content no matter how Karder behaved earlier. While this ensures that you will see almost all the content in one playthrough, it does somehow take the weight off some decisions and reduce the incentive to play again. [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Since Steam doesn't offer polls for some reason, if you want to weigh in please you the following expressions at the start of your post so it will be easier for me to get a bird's eye impression:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Less girls, more content for each / More girls, less content for each (i.e. same amount of girls as now, no change).

Add more branches than there are currently in the game, decisions matter more / No branches, no decisions, I want to see as much content as possible in one playthrough.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]If there is any other thing you’d like to see different in the next game, let me know. As for 0.15: I hope to have an ETA for 0.15 next week. I’m also talking to a new developer, so there might be some good news there too.[/p][p]
[/p][p]As always, thank you for your ongoing support! If you did not get to review the game, now would be a great time to do so.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]

[/p]

Looking at it now, I know how far I’ve come, and how much those early scenes needed love. Enclosing a very simple comparison of the same image, one currently in the game, the other from the coming version. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/933f9757f6e636761082a7d18822f69be9354b31.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/308eee48c4da5346a556b02e45989d69b11b7ce4.png"][/img][/p][p]And Marbia isn’t just the Ziruan oasis quest. But the results speak for themselves: the renders are crisp, the colors more lively, and the animations really bring the lewd scenes to life.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]The Strange News[/b][/h3][p align="start"]You might notice I’m calling this update [b]0.15[/b] and not [b]1.0[/b], as originally intended.[/p][p align="start"]While I handle art, dialogue, plot, and freelancers, I’ve had a long-time partner, [b]Gojira667[/b], who has been working on the coding side, especially the world map and meta-game systems. Unfortunately, I’ve lost contact with him. My last interaction with him was on [b]July 26[/b], and since then… silence.[/p][p align="start"]Because of the privacy involved in working on adult games, I don’t have alternative channels to reach him. If he doesn’t resurface soon, I’ll need to find a new developer. Such is life in the 21st century of distributed teams, I guess.[/p][p align="start"]This doesn’t affect my ability to create [b]“pure AVN”[/b] content, but it does delay the final release. There are still key Khaganate management features I want in place before I can confidently call the game [i]finished[/i].[/p][h3][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The update is still coming, and since Alam and Nahir are among the most popular girls in the game, I think you’ll enjoy this return to the oasis.[/p][p align="start"][b]Thank you as always for your support, it means the world.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Vae Victis - Khan: Version 0.14 is Live!
notes.notes:
[p]This major update marks the end of a long journey—Karder has finally crossed the Sea of Knives. The final act of the story begins now.

🗡️ Story Progression

Karder sets foot on the Western Sister. The invasion has begun.

⚔️ New Features & Improvements

Streamlined 1:1 Combat: Fewer clicks, faster pace, and stylish new backgrounds make duels smoother and more cinematic.

New MK2 Unit Types: Expand your tactical options with fresh unit types in army battles.

All-New Fiefdom Screen: Manage your conquests with a clearer, more intuitive interface.

Original Soundtracks: Four powerful new tracks enhance the most dramatic moments of this update.

Queen Yidril Council Bonus: She now brings a unique benefit when serving on your Council.

As always, thank you for supporting Vae Victis - Khan. If you’re enjoying the journey, please consider leaving a review—every thumbs up helps more than you can imagine, especially for a small indie team.

Destiny awaits across the Sea of Knives![/p][p][/p][p]*Note that the content for this version triggers after you conquer all the fiefdoms and wait a few turns.*[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.14 launch date – The Reunion Approaches
notes.notes:
We're almost there.

On June 7th, Vae Victis – Khan will receive its biggest update yet: Version 0.14, featuring the long-awaited meeting between Karder and Queen Remy. This update marks a major turning point in the story, filled with emotion, conflict, and the kind of character-driven drama many of you have been waiting for.

As always, thank you for your support, your feedback, and your patience. Making a game of this scope as a solo indie developer is no small feat—and your encouragement keeps the fire burning.

If you’ve enjoyed the journey so far and haven’t left a review yet, I’d be incredibly grateful if you took a moment to do so. Every thumbs up helps more than you know.

See you June 7th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/c4aaeceb3b5a256499c13bb20acbf23c7a23411f.png[/img]

notes.title: 🔥 Version 0.14 — Late April Update 🔥
notes.notes:
We’re in the final stretch.

No hard ETA just yet — I don’t like to promise a date I can’t absolutely commit to — but what I can tell you is this: Version 0.14 is the biggest update I’ve ever made. It’s not delayed because of burnout or bugs — it’s delayed because it just keeps growing. And it’s almost ready.

If you’ve followed me for a while, you know I don’t chase numbers. I don’t post image or animation counts because I don’t want to feel pressured to inflate them with filler. I do keep track for myself, though — and let’s just say this version’s stats are... ridiculous.

💥 Previous versions averaged ~20 animations. This one? Already past 80.

Why? Queen Remy is getting not two but three full routes this time — which means more scenes, more variations, and way more content than usual. And if you’ve been following Karder’s story, you know he’s been obsessing over the queen for over four years… so yeah, I may have gotten a little carried away adding new scenes. No regrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/10a19310fd804f49fd6038eb1cff64378851dfbc.gif[/img]

🎮 On top of that, we’ve reworked the R/P/S interface — the flow is smoother now, with fewer clicks and better pacing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/d9537d2c1267d5b840c3166a97af610e4d2496ca.gif[/img]

Next post will include the final ETA. Thank you all for your support and patience — this one’s going to be worth the wait.

Finally: if you didn't Review the game yet, please take a few seconds to do so. Thanks!

notes.title: Version 0.14 April update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Version 0.14 is shaping up really well, and I’m hoping to share an ETA for release soon. This one’s big—probably the second or third largest update so far—so it’s taking a bit longer to get everything just right.

One major change I’ve decided to make is instead of having only Seduction/Dominance routes for Queen Remy, add a third path: Reluctance. In this route, Queen Remy is caught in emotional conflict—she doesn’t fully reject Karder, but she can’t embrace him either. She’s torn, and it adds a rich new layer to the story. It’s turning out really cool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/1fb09508a38a6b727eb144f58d676eb310f61f3a.png[/img]

While I focus on the narrative, Gojira has been busy with several awesome metagame features, which I’ll dive into more in a future post. Here’s a quick preview:

    Streamlined 1:1 combat with fewer clicks and stylish new backgrounds

    New unit types in MK2 army battles

    Varied travel times for units between fiefdoms

    Building construction times

    Portuguese and Chinese translations

    And four brand-new soundtracks for the big moments in this update

Karder’s first chapter is building to a powerful and unforgettable climax. Thanks for your patience—this one’s going to be worth the wait!

notes.title: Wow! Version 0.14!
notes.notes:
Version 0.14 will mark the end of the story for Vae Victis - Khan. This doesn’t mean the journey is completely over, but any future updates will focus on infrastructure improvements, tying up loose ends, and similar refinements.

[b]What’s Coming in Version 0.14?[/b]

At the start of this chapter, Karder stands on the brink of invading the Western Sister. But just as the campaign is about to begin, a key character vanishes, throwing everything into disarray. Trust among his closest allies is shaken, the secrets of The Harsh Edge remain elusive, and Karder even contemplates delaying the invasion.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/c52a600fcb2d26e6593cf4cf2a7b745f40242138.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/9082cb6cca3ed9b9f3bee8e82c3e75c132aabf67.png[/img][/url]

The climax of this update will feature a long-awaited moment: Karder finally meets Queen Remy. And yes, expect those “happy reunion” scenes you’ve been waiting for. 😏

But this isn’t the end of Karder’s tale. The story will continue in the next game, tentatively titled Vae Victis - Khan: Across the Sea of Knives. There’s much more to explore, and I can’t wait to take you there.

[b]A Different Format[/b]

This update will unfold as a series of scenes, without the usual map or mission structure. Think of it as a cinematic finale to this chapter of the story.

[b]When Will It Be Ready?[/b]

I don’t have a release date just yet, but I’ll keep you updated as development progresses.

[b]Sneak Peeks and More[/b]

As always, I’m active on Discord, where I often share thoughts, images, and ideas. Feel free to drop by and join the conversation!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/11e360e42445031205d5a978bbb7b359efb6c2c9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/731148cbf9f93ae75b979575da489ab9d168f7b2.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for your incredible support. Version 0.14 wouldn’t be possible without you, and I’m beyond excited to share the culmination of this chapter with you soon.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/0d8f0a311c700ccbd8a59901b7f3e49a5371c2d9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/c83078e750768755f63c4fd3a6c6c57ff0fc3e16.png[/img][/url]

[b]Final note: the Codex.[/b]

Those who are playing an early access version of the game might want to download the latest version (0.13.7) which has the Codex for your enjoyment. Just remember that statistics for existing games might not be 100% accurate. We did our best to retrieve information based on persistent data, but that method is not 100% guaranteed. 

Stay tuned,

notes.title: Version 0.13 is here!
notes.notes:
I don't want to repeat the full feature list, you can find it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2540230/Vae_Victis__Khan/?curator_clanid=34401214]here[/url]. However, there are some minor additions to this version which were not specified in the previous Release Notes:

1. In the army Vs. army combat you now have three additional formations to help you gain some flexibility in combat. 
[list]
[*] [b]Shield Wall[/b] Formation (granted by Sumia in your palace): Units adjacent to each other take reduced damage.  
[*] [b]Flank Formation[/b] (granted by Dian in your palace): When an enemy unit is attacked from opposite sides, it takes increased damage.  
[*] [b]Berserk[/b] Damage Bonus A friendly unit attacking without adjacent allies gains an extra damage bonus.

[/list]

2. Following the inclusion of formations, when starting a new game, you may now play the game with a more strategic approach: After conquering Oryenguk and Marbia, you can plan your next move toward dominating the Eastern Sister. Here are a few strategic options to consider.

[list]
[*] Heading North to Geoyanguk: Capturing this region unlocks Queen Xeneny’s powerful Fame bonuses. Extreme fame or infamy can significantly boost obedience or productivity across your fiefdoms.

[*] Advancing West to Tinpingia and Waikokipia: Securing these areas improves your army’s mobility, enabling faster troop movements. This allows for more efficient control over obedience and minimizes the downtime when troops are away from your fiefdoms.

[*] Marching South to Hawatia and Limtinia: Bringing their queens into your council unlocks the Shield Wall and Flank formations, granting crucial tactical advantages in Army vs. Army MK2 combat.
[/list]

3. Unfortunately, the Codex will be released later.
4. Thank you all for your ongoing support! If you’re enjoying the game, I would greatly appreciate it if you could leave a review. As a small independent developer, your feedback helps me gain visibility and stand out.

notes.title: Version 0.13 final status
notes.notes:
In the story "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/How_Much_Land_Does_a_Man_Need%3F]How Much Land Does a Man Need?[/url]" by Tolstoy, a peasant's greed for more land leads to his demise, as he dies trying to claim more than he can use. When I approach the end of a version, I feel like Pahom, the story’s protagonist: only I’m not driven by greed, but by the desire to push more content into the version: Another scene. Another animation. Another dialog. 

Anyway, content wise, the version is near complete. All dialogs, images and animations will be ready tomorrow. What’s left are the somewhat less “shiny” tasks of adding gallery scenes, music and lewd sounds in lewd scenes, proofreading, playtesting, reviewing the tutorial etc. Additionally, since we have added a Codex, codex entries need to be added as well (though this might wait for a later date).

As I have written in earlier posts, the quest in this version is about Karder who visits the Pirate Clans in order to secure their cooperation when the Khan’s navy crosses the Sea of Knives. Additionally’ we’ll meet the Harsh Edge, his divine daughter and will “reunite” with his little sister, Alyn. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/ee9d6f5b9b4b2d57aac837607a72ac2c101a3239.png[/img]

I may be able to squeeze in a lewd scene with pregnant Jada, but that may or may not happen. 

But after finishing this version, Karder will be ready to cross the Sea of Knives. It’s happening.

Looking at the new features, there are a lots of new surprises:

1. Codex. This is something which was requested many times in the past for various reasons, with the most popular being; how many children did Karder sire? And how do I know what bonus do my Council Wenches provide? So now the codex will provide statistics for this question, along with lore and information on all the Wenches, non-Wenches important characters, Deities, fiefdoms and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/222a241005a8d49aa9ce5e815c0ea4d36d14eeee.png[/img]

2. Threat Level and Covert Ops screen. Since the first days of the game, enemy fiefdoms attacks were always completely random. As of version 0.13 each fiefdom will be assigned a Threat Level (based on the ruling Wench) which will increase gradually. In order to mitigate the threat, you’ll be able to bribe enemy generals (with gold), execute a Preemptive Strike (“spending” troops from the main army) or declare Martial Law in your adjacent fiefdoms, thus forcing the enemy to cancel their raid plans but losing Morale (= productiveness) in your adjacent fiefdoms. In other words: the metagame will be less random, allowing you to plan your khagante’s growth better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/cfc0462d9de89e8c12f89fdd9ca1958b1ade4325.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/2d998c7dfa6f0669e92e4b2a8feadcbf79b33897.png[/img]

3. MK2 Combat formations. The Army Vs. Army MK2 combat, where you fight in 3 Vs 3 against the enemy will become the default option (can be changed in the game settings). In order to make it more interesting, the following “formations” were added.

Berserk: if your unit (i.e. on screen soldier) is not adjacent to any other friendly unit, it does more damage.
Shield Wall: if your unit is adjacent to another friendly unit (not diagonally), it receives a defence bonus.
Flanking: if two of your units attack the same enemy unit, they receive a damage bonus.

Don’t worry, I’m not trying to compete with Total War, just make the army combat slightly more interesting and fun.

4. Nicer nodes on the minimap in quests. Unfortunately there is no new minimap in version 0.13 so you’ll have to replay a quest to see this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/fb698c02a158c746b9847b64e7c3485229cd789e.png[/img]

5. Moving during a miniquest can now be controlled from the keyboard keys instead of clicking on the on-screen arrows.

6. Toggleable Incest. This is something I hear from time to time, some of you prefer not to have it in the game. Incest is now toggleable in the Fetish settings but the default is on.

That's it for now, now I'll go back to finish this adventure filled version. I’ll publish an ETA by the end of the week. Let’s fucking go!

notes.title: Version 0.13 status
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Version 0.13 is going to be the last version before Karder crosses the Sea of Knives and reunites with Queen Remy. So in this version I'm trying to tie all manner of loose ends to make the reunion as exciting as possible: Karder is going to meet with Queen Remy's daughter Alyn, get to know The Harsh Edge (who, you'd be surprised, looks exactly like beautiful young woman) and in addition there's also a quest in the Pirate Clans, filled to the brim with alluring pirate ladies and many game related enhancements.

If this wasn't clear, version 0.13 is probably going to be the biggest version ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/4e4cbaa7a0907c10119e0557a7e4e9fc77bb19bc.png[/img]

All this comes at a price: the version will not make it to September and will be released in late October/early November. I hate delaying a version and perhaps I should not have added a quest to this one (and simply focus on the meta story going), but I just couldn't refuse those hot pirate babes, and hopefully you'll fall in love with them like I did.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/0d6ac82c7a4f2d2e8edc75a5e0417874af5e67ce.png[/img]

From a game enhancement perspective, 0.13 is also filled to the brim with new features, which will be detailed in a future post, but as a teaser, here are their names:

-   Codex

-   World Map Fiefdom Threat Level

-   MK2 combat formations

-   Toggleable Incest

-   Improved minimap nodes

-   Keyboard controlled Minimap

Last but not least, an original pirate-themed soundtrack. Let me know in the comments if you'd like some musical samples!

Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/9676020a43fa7ea7e440edf9fe4d88d2d2d85a8e.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.13 update
notes.notes:
Version 0.13 is going great! So much content planned, it might be the biggest update yet. As you might have guessed, the new update will take Karder to the Pirate Clans. As many have you noticed, there are three unconquered fiefdoms left (Ganguk, Taishing and Cheunia) and since they are so small I can't think of any feasible scenario where they dare to defy Karder or pose any significant threat, hence they will be known collectively as the Pirate Clans.

Karder will visit the Pirate Clans to bargain for a safe passage over the Sea of Knives and go on a pirate themed adventure with no "Aaaarrrrgggghhhh!!" or "Matey" but a lot of other exciting shenanigans of the nautical criminal nature. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/06af7501e091311d504aaa8eba19020c7bd550bf.png[/img]

If you missed the tiny ladies, there's one coming up in the form of Ktani the halfling and her crow who loves shouting "cocksucker!" whenever it can. I will reveal the rest of the cast in the coming weeks, but trust me it's going to be hot. We're also working on many gameplay features such as a codex (including the number of bastards Karder sired), Threat Level indicator for the world map, allowing you to manage risks of raids, new music tracks of course and many more. Come visit me in Discord (https://discord.gg/zP5FH9x8hv), I post a lot of stuff there.

[*]Narrative. Narrative is how Karder views the world and the source of his ambition. The Narrative is *only* used in certain conversations and is *never* a deciding factor on whether the player will have access to lewd scenes on any content. I created this mechanism so players could approach Karder in different ways and for me to be able to explore Karder's personality a little deeper than "mine! want it!". 
[*]If Karder's Narrative is *Benign*, Karder sees his goal to become the Khan as an effort to prevent the chaos and bloodshed caused by the disintegration of the khaganate. He also remembers his late father fondly and has a softer attitude towards fatherhood.
[*]If Karder's Narrative is *Vengeful*, Karder is out to get what's his and woe to anyone who stands in his way. He was wronged, and he wants revenge. In Vengeful mood Karder sees his late father as a weak ruler and wishes to become his opposite.

Narrative is governed by Fame. When Fame is high, the Narrative will automatically switch to benign and when it is very negative, it switches to Vengeful. Again: whichever Narrative the game is on, you can always still choose *any* path you want, Dominance or Seduction. If Karder is in a benign mood, some of his text will be displayed in *green*. If he is vengeful, some of his text will be displayed in *red*.

[*]Achievements: new achievements for all Fame levels, an achievement if you manage to achieve all Fame levels in one game aptly called Fickle and achievements if you use all Shadow Institute functions in all your fiefdoms. 

[/list]

Enjoy! And if you enjoyed the update, please review the game!
